title: Data Center Foreman
description:
RIGHTECH is a leading nationwide provider of technical staffing services, and we are currently seeking qualified Data Center Technicians for hyperscale data center build in Fredericksburg, VA. Candidates with VA Data badges are encouraged to apply.
The projects are scheduled to kick off as early as next week.

The primary responsibility is to support the installation of infrastructure and cabling materials related to data center builds outs.
  • Install fiber tray, ladder rack, Unistrut, basket tray and cabinets
  • Cable infrastructure and Fiber rough in
  • Cable management (dressing, labeling testing)
  • Material receiving and hardware assembly
  • Read and follow blueprints set for installation
  • Follow written and oral communication displaying professionalism
  • Follow safety guidelines and protocols (Proper PPE, clean up jobsite, OSHA).
Certifications Desired but not required:
- OSHA 10
- Scissor Lift Certification
Required Tools:
  • Basic hand tools, Screwdriver (multi-Bit), Torpedo level, Tape measure, Snips, Pliers (needle nose and channel locks), Cable stripper, punch down tool, modular plug crimper, Flashlight, Electrical tape, Impact driver
PPE:
  • Safety Vest, Safety Glasses, Work Gloves Level IV Cut resistant, Hard Hat (Class E Type 2), Work Boots (composite)

title: Project Coordinator
description:
RIGHTECH is a leading nationwide provider of technical staffing services, and we are currently seeking qualified candidates for a Project Coordinator in Hackensack, NJ starting ASAP.

Job Title: Project Coordinator
Location: Hackensack, NJ
Duration: Contract to hire
Start Date: ASAP
Job Description:

Role Overview

The Project Coordinator supports senior Project Managers and Market Leaders in day-to-day project execution. This role is designed for someone eager to expand their project management skills by coordinating logistics, tracking progress, and ensuring project documentation and communication are accurate and timely.

You will gain exposure to project scheduling, budgeting, and customer interactions while still receiving guidance and mentorship from experienced managers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist Project Managers in coordinating and monitoring project activities from launch to close-out.
  • Support Client scheduling and resource planning.
  • Manage project documentation, including certifications, as-builts, and close-out packages.
  • Handle project logistics such as shipping, receiving, inventory control, and material reuse.
  • Prepare weekly reports and updates on project status for internal teams and customers.
  • Track and verify invoices, payroll, and project-related expenses.
  • Monitor and maintain asset tracking and certifications.
  • Ensure project compliance with company standards and customer requirements.

Requirements

  • Experience: 1–3 years in telecommunications, construction, or a related technical role (wireless background preferred).
  • Education: High school diploma required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a technical or business field preferred.

Skills:

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple teams.

Schedule; Monday - Friday 8:30-5
